title: 912. Long Pressed Name

examples.explanation: The letters 'a' and 'e' were held a little longer.
The count of 'e' does not line up.

hints: Track one index into the intended name while scanning the typed text from left to right.
A typed character either consumes the next needed name character or repeats the previous typed character.
If the scan ends with unmatched name characters left over, the answer is false.
